mainEntity.name: Can functional medicine help insulin resistance and prediabetes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We address insulin resistance by working on what drives it, blood sugar, weight, and inflammation, alongside your primary care. Many people see their markers improve as the root causes are addressed.

mainEntity.name: Do you replace my regular doctor for diabetes or blood pressure?

acceptedAnswer.text: We work alongside your primary and specialty care. Our focus is the root-cause and lifestyle side that addresses why your numbers are rising.

mainEntity.name: What testing do you run for metabolic health?

acceptedAnswer.text: We go beyond a basic panel, with A1c, A1c, a full lipid and inflammation panel, and blood pressure, so the plan targets your specific root causes.

mainEntity.name: I was told I am borderline. Why act now?

acceptedAnswer.text: The years before a diagnosis are the most changeable. Addressing insulin resistance early is the best chance to keep your numbers from crossing the line.

mainEntity.name: Can these changes really move my numbers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often, yes. Nutrition, movement, sleep, and targeted support can meaningfully improve blood sugar, weight, and other markers over time. We track it with you.

mainEntity.name: Will I have to go on medication?

acceptedAnswer.text: That is a decision you make with your doctors. We focus on the root-cause work, and where medication fits, we pair it with the changes that address the cause.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer virtual metabolic care or only in person in Atlanta?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both. See Dr. Nina Ross in person at our Atlanta clinic, or virtually anywhere in Georgia. Your $99 Symptom Consultation can be booked either way.

sections.label: Hero

headings.text: Root-cause metabolic care in Atlanta that helps you get ahead of blood sugar.

paragraphs: If your blood sugar is creeping up, your weight is climbing and you have been told you are borderline and to watch it, you are not imagining it.

These early signals are real, and they deserve someone who will look closely before they become a diagnosis. At Nina Ross Functional Medicine, we support metabolic health at its root, here in Atlanta and virtually across Georgia. Dr. Nina Ross follows the whole picture, insulin, weight, and inflammation, to understand what is driving your numbers, then builds the plan around your body and your life, working alongside your primary care.

sections.label: Why conventional care misses it

headings.text: You were told you are borderline, just watch it.

eyebrowSpans: Why conventional care keeps missing it
paragraphs: A fifteen-minute visit rarely has room to look at the whole metabolic picture. So early warning signs get watched rather than addressed, and the chance to change the path goes unused.

boldPairs.title: What you’re usually told
boldPairs.body: “You are borderline. Let us just keep an eye on it and recheck next year.”

boldPairs.title: What’s actually happening
boldPairs.body: Insulin, weight, and inflammation are reinforcing each other in a loop. Address the loop early and the numbers can move the other way.

sections.label: The functional medicine difference

headings.text: We will not wait for the diagnosis to act.

paragraphs: Here is where we part ways with conventional care. Early metabolic changes are often watched until they cross a line into diagnosis, then met with a prescription. Watching has its place. But the years before a diagnosis are the most changeable, and using them to address insulin resistance directly is where the real opportunity lives.
We would rather do the harder, more honest work. We find what is driving your metabolic numbers and we address that, alongside your primary care.
If medication still has a place in your care, that should be your informed choice, made with the full picture in front of you, and paired with the work that addresses the cause.

boldPairs.title: Watching is not the same as acting
boldPairs.body: The borderline years are the most reversible, and they deserve a real plan.

boldPairs.title: Numbers tell a story together
boldPairs.body: Blood sugar, weight, and blood pressure move as a system, so we read them together.

boldPairs.title: Early action changes the path
boldPairs.body: Addressing insulin resistance now is what helps you stay ahead of a diagnosis.

sections.label: The root-cause view

headings.text: Metabolic risk runs in a loop. We map the whole circle.

paragraphs: Each driver pushes the next. That is why treating one in isolation rarely holds, and why mapping the full cycle changes everything.
When we look at your metabolic health, we read the whole picture rather than a single number, and connect each driver back to what you’re experiencing:
